description: Header file defining structures, function pointer types, and API functions related to actions and backend handling in the lighttpd web server project.

methods.name: li_action_stack_reset
methods.description: Resets the action stack for a given request.

methods.name: li_action_stack_clear
methods.description: Clears the action stack for a given request.

methods.name: li_action_enter
methods.description: Handles sublist entry, saving current position.

methods.name: li_action_execute
methods.description: Executes the current action in the request context.

methods.name: li_action_release
methods.description: Releases a reference to an action.

methods.name: li_action_acquire
methods.description: Increments reference count for an action.

methods.name: li_action_new_setting
methods.description: Creates a new action with a setting.

methods.name: li_action_new_settingptr
methods.description: Creates a new action with a pointer setting.

methods.name: li_action_new_function
methods.description: Creates a new action with a function callback.

methods.name: li_action_new_list
methods.description: Creates a new list of actions.

methods.name: li_action_new_balancer
methods.description: Creates a new balancer action with backend callbacks.

methods.name: li_action_append_inplace
methods.description: Appends an element to an action list in place.
